in_hebrew.name: חלדס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Haldes is derived from the Hebrew word חלד (chald), which means 'young warrior'. In the context of biblical names, this name would signify a brave and strong warrior in the service of God.

in_greek.name: ἅλδης
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Haldes is derived from the Greek word ἅλδης (haldēs), which means 'strong one, warrior'. In the ancient Greek culture, this name was given to children born into warrior families or those who showed great potential in combat.

in_latin.name: Haldesius
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Haldesius is derived from the Latin word haldex (noble warrior). In the Roman Empire, this name was given to children born into noble families or those who demonstrated exceptional courage and strength in battle.
